headline: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited receives NSE/BSE observation letter for amalgamation/merger
sum: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited has received no-adverse-objection observation letters from both BSE and NSE for a proposed amalgamation/merger transaction. The transaction has cleared stock exchange regulatory review and is progressing toward statutory approvals.
implication: Receipt of exchange observation letters signals completion of preliminary regulatory gating; transacting parties must now secure shareholder/creditor approval under the Companies Act 2013 Scheme mechanism and proceed to NCLT/High Court sanctioning, the final statutory hurdle before merger implementation.
detail: Markolines Pavement Technologies Limited, an infrastructure and pavement technology company, announced clearance from both NSE and BSE on its proposed amalgamation/merger on 18 August 2026. The observation letters confirm no regulatory objection from the exchanges, a mandatory step under Regulation 37 of the Listing Rules before a listed company can proceed with a merger scheme. The status of the merger parties (whether one is acquiring the other, or if it is a consolidation) and the consideration have not been disclosed in the exchange filing. The next stage requires shareholder approval via postal ballot and/or general meeting, followed by creditor objection proceedings and NCLT/High Court scheme sanctioning under Sections 230–232 of the Companies Act 2013.
